name: Discrete FET — Infineon
description: This cluster contains 14 surface-mount discrete FET components sourced from KiCad symbols, all assigned to quality tier B and utilizing Infineon footprint packages.
selection_hints: Choose when requiring surface-mount (SMD) discrete FET parts from the KiCad symbols library.
Select based on exact footprint requirements such as PG-HDSOP-10-1, PG-HSOF-8-3, PG-LSON-8-1, PG-DSO-20-85, PG-DSO-20-87, or PG-HSOF-8-2.
Note that all 14 parts in this cluster are categorized under quality tier B.
avoid_when: The design requires through-hole or non-SMD mounting options.
A footprint outside the listed Infineon PG-HDSOP, PG-HSOF, PG-LSON, or PG-DSO footprint variants is required.
Quality tier A classification is strictly mandated for the component selection.
